focus.winter: Be gentle with yourself. Rest without guilt.
focus.spring: Your energy is slowly returning. A good moment to start something.
focus.summer: You're glowing. Make the most of this time to connect with others.
focus.autumn: Turn inward. Listen to what you need.

partnerSuggestion.winter: Offer a calm moment. Your presence matters more than words.
partnerSuggestion.spring: Her energy is back. Plan something enjoyable together.
partnerSuggestion.summer: She's at her peak. Share in that vibrant energy with her.
partnerSuggestion.autumn: She may be more introspective. Be attentive without pushing.

cards.title: Restorative yoga
cards.body: Gentle poses to ease lower-belly tension.

cards.title: Mindful walking
cards.body: 20 minutes at your own pace, no pressure.

cards.title: Warmth & rest
cards.body: Hot water bottle, herbal tea, a blanket. You have permission to slow down.

cards.title: Your body is renewing
cards.body: Your period marks the renewal of your cycle. It's a time for letting go.

cards.title: Pilates
cards.body: Build your core strength gradually.

cards.title: Cycling or swimming
cards.body: Your body is ready for more energy.

cards.title: Start something
cards.body: A great time to kick off a project or a new habit.

cards.title: Estrogen is rising
cards.body: Mental clarity, optimism, sociability — your renewal phase is in full swing.

cards.title: HIIT or running
cards.body: Your stamina is at its peak. Time to push your limits.

cards.title: Dance or team sport
cards.body: Channel your social energy into movement.

cards.title: Connection & sharing
cards.body: You're magnetic. Surround yourself with people who nourish you.

cards.title: Energy peak
cards.body: Communication, creativity and confidence are at their highest.

cards.title: Yoga or stretching
cards.body: Favor mobility over performance.

cards.title: Walking in nature
cards.body: Autumn nature invites contemplation.

cards.title: Journaling
cards.body: Putting words to what you feel can release inner tension.

cards.title: Progesterone takes over
cards.body: You may feel more sensitive. That's normal and temporary.

cards.title: Less is more
cards.body: Offer your presence without expecting much in return. A hug, a home-cooked meal.

cards.title: Movie & couch
cards.body: A calm moment at home, no agenda.

cards.title: It's not about you
cards.body: The fatigue and sensitivity of this time are physiological, not emotional.

cards.title: Encourage her momentum
cards.body: She's coming back to life — support her initiatives with enthusiasm.

cards.title: A new activity
cards.body: Suggest something you've never done together.

cards.title: Energy is back
cards.body: A good time for important conversations.

cards.title: Be present in the exchange
cards.body: She's at her best — truly connect with her.

cards.title: A social or romantic outing
cards.body: Dinner, a concert, a night out — she enjoys showing up and sharing.

cards.title: Her energy peak
cards.body: Ovulation heightens communication and sociability.

cards.title: Patience & listening
cards.body: She may be more sensitive. Don't take mood shifts personally.

cards.title: A quiet evening for two
cards.body: Cook together, watch something she loves.

cards.title: Introspection rises
cards.body: It's not a rejection, it's a physiological need.

deactivateConfirm.title: Deactivate my account
deactivateConfirm.message: Your account will be paused and your data hidden. You can reactivate it by signing back in. This does not affect your partner.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete permanently
deleteConfirm.message: This action is irreversible: your account and all your data will be deleted. Your partner is not affected.

reactivate.body: Your account is paused. Reactivate it to get your data back, or stay signed out.
